set.body:
Objective
Determinant fields with typed non-positive handling.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (D5.4). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
upstream reframe4s-field (TopologyAssessor). Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. det <= 0 reported as fold mask and count; log-Jacobian NonPositive status (no NaN/-Inf).
2. Analytic cases: affine constant det, radial scaling, chain rule for composed pairs.
3. Pull/push mode enum named without JacobianMode.

Verification
reframe4s tests on JVM and JS; pin bumped.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-U4: reframe4s: Jacobian and log-Jacobian determinant fields with fold status
